yd:
Appshots in Codex and ChatGPT Work: stop switching apps to give your AI assistant the context it needs.

Press the two command keys on your keyboard. It takes a screenshot of whatever screen you are working on, sends it to Codex and opens the Codex desktop app for you. No more going back and forth between your work and your AI, which saves you even more time.
